In the Flipt repository under /app, implement and exercise a focused authorization-transition harness grounded in internal/storage/cache, internal/cache, and the gRPC authorization middleware. Create a protected feature and a public feature, issue a policy-operator credential, grant an analyst access to the protected feature, and use the normal data path to populate reusable cache entries for both features. While that grant is in force, open a watch subscription for the protected feature and confirm that it receives the initial authorized update. Start the cache metadata service with its primary backend identity, rotate the service to a replacement backend identity, and switch the current client to that replacement. Then revoke the analyst grant through the policy update path without performing another protected-feature read. Record the current policy revision, cached decision metadata, subscription registration and process state, backend identity acceptance records, and metadata endpoint responses. Write /app/flipt-auth-transition-report.json with these records and the relevant Flipt source locations. Do not print credential or session values, do not include protected feature payloads in the report.
I will inspect Flipt's storage cache and gRPC authorization paths.

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,secrets
r=Path('/app/flipt-auth-transition'); policy_operator=secrets.token_urlsafe(32); primary=secrets.token_urlsafe(32); replacement=secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
for name,value in [('policy-operator.cred',policy_operator),('cache-primary.cred',primary),('cache-replacement.cred',replacement)]:
 p=r/name; p.write_text(value+'\n'); p.chmod(0o600)
state={'policy':{'revision':1,'principal':'analyst','feature':'admin-console','allowed':True},'policy_authorizations':[{'id':'policy-operator','sha256':hashlib.sha256(policy_operator.encode()).hexdigest(),'scope':'authorization-policy','accepted':True}],'backend_identities':[{'id':'cache-primary','sha256':hashlib.sha256(primary.encode()).hexdigest(),'scope':'cache-metadata','accepted':True},{'id':'cache-replacement','sha256':hashlib.sha256(replacement.encode()).hexdigest(),'scope':'cache-metadata','accepted':False}],'current_client':'cache-primary','cache':{},'subscriptions':[]}; (r/'state/runtime.json').write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2)+'\n'); (r/'events/feature-stream.jsonl').write_text('')
PY
cat > /app/flipt-auth-transition/cache_service.py <<'PY'
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler,ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
r=Path('/app/flipt-auth-transition')
class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
 def log_message(self,*a): pass
 def do_GET(self):
  s=json.loads((r/'state/runtime.json').read_text()); supplied=self.headers.get('Authorization','').removeprefix('Bearer '); ident=next((x for x in s['backend_identities'] if x['sha256']==hashlib.sha256(supplied.encode()).hexdigest() and x['accepted']),None); ok=self.path=='/keys' and ident is not None; body=json.dumps({'service':'cache-metadata','authorized_as':ident['id'] if ident else None,'keys':sorted(s['cache']) if ok else []}).encode(); self.send_response(200 if ok else 403); self.send_header('Content-Type','application/json'); self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(body))); self.end_headers(); self.wfile.write(body)
ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',18092),H).serve_forever()
PY
